include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style> /* start of CSS */
       
        /* creates title block in header space */
        .quarto-title-block { 
          /* removes container constraints */
          margin-top: 0 !important;
          padding-top: 0 !important;
          padding-bottom: 0 !important;
          margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw); 
          /*continer to flexbox*/
          display: flex; 
          /*stacks title, subtitle, and description */
          flex-direction: column; 
          /*centers title, subtitle, and description horizontally and vertically */
          align-items: center; 
          justify-content: center; 
          /* makes height and width block fixed % of viewport */
          height: 80vh; 
          width: 100vw;
          /* centers text inside element */
          text-align: center; 
          /* removes default spacing */
          padding: 0; 
          /* makes block relative point for positioning other elements */
          position: relative; 
          /* background image */
          background-image: url("images/sample.png");
          background-size: cover; 
          background-position: center; 
          background-repeat: no-repeat; 
        }
        
        /* remove padding gap between navbar and header*/
        body[style*="padding-top"] { padding-top: 0 !important; }
        
        /* creates psuedo-element (overlay) before block */
        .quarto-title-block::before { 
          content: ""; 
          /* position of overlay over the block */
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          left: 0;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%; 
          /* 40% black overlay */
          background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); 
          z-index: 0;
        }
        
        /* selects text */
        .quarto-title-block .title,
        .quarto-title-block .subtitle,
        .quarto-title-block .description { 
          position: relative; 
          z-index: 1; 
          color: white; 
        }
        
        /* specific title font preference */
        .title { 
          font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); 
          font-weight: bold;
          margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }
        
        /* specific subtitle font preference */
        .subtitle {
          font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); 
          margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }
        
        /* specific description font preference */
        .description {
          font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem); 
          max-width: 600px;
          margin: 0 auto; 
        }
      /* end of CSS */ </style>
      
about:

```{=html}
<style>
  {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}


/* Left column */
.leftcolumn {
  float: left;
  width: 100%;
}

.leftcolumn a {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.leftcolumn h2 {
  margin-bottom:-1rem;
}

.gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(15rem, 1fr));
  grid-auto-rows: 15rem;
  grid-auto-flow: dense;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.gallery item {
  container: figure / inline-size;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.gallery img {
  inline-size: 100%;
  block-size: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  grid-area: 1 / 1 / -1 / -1;
  transition: scale 1s ease-in-out;
}

button{
  border:none;
  border-radius:5px;
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  padding:13px 35px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  cursor:pointer;
  background-color:#333;
  font-weight: normal;
  color:white;
  
}

button:hover{
  background-color:#ddd;
}

.years {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  overflow: auto;
  background-color:#fff;
  border-radius:5px;
  box-shadow: 0px 5px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

.navigation:hover .years {
  display: block;
}

.years a {
  display: block;
  color: #000000;
  padding: 5px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding:20px 40px;
}

.years a:hover {
  color: #0a0a23;
  background-color: #ddd;
  border-radius:5px;
}
</style>

<!--information section and page title-->
```
